_comment: The chapter dividers in journal_club_template.pptx, and the short pill each gets in the navigation bar. Edit here and re-run scripts/set_chapters.py; nothing else holds these strings. 'slide' is the absolute slide number in the template as PowerPoint shows it.
_casing: Sentence case with a 'Category:' prefix, which is the template's own convention - five of the eight titles it arrived with used it. The three that were SHOUTING had been retitled by the slides repo's rename_chapter.py, which is an accident of that history and not a design. Earth_Custom Layout sets no cap='all', so what is written here is what shows on the slide.
_pills: Roughly 12 characters of room. Without a pill, nav_bar.py falls back to whatever prefix of the title fits, which for 'Example: What it showed' would have been 'Methods' - the same word as the chapter before it.

_title_slide: A draft title - change it here and re-run, it is one edit. The date is deliberately an empty line rather than a guess: nothing in this repo records when the talk is. The vitiligo deck wrote its date as DD.MM.YYYY, which is the convention to follow.
